prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions frequently overestimated positive impact overall, but underestimated strong wins in rounds 3, 4, and 6.
home wait_info changes are often helpful (4 winning tests in rounds 3, 4, 7, and 9), though 5 tests showed no clear effect.
sign_in hint changes can be helpful (2 winning tests in rounds 4 and 6), though 7 tests showed no clear effect.
sign_in reorder and adoption new_flow changes proved consistently harmful across agreeing tests.
choose_path layout, finish copy, and home notification changes consistently showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests each.
Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for adoption redesign, finish new_flow, finish new_screen, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, and single-test categories.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Persistent Account Pet Restore Reassurance Hint: Display a clear hint on the sign in screen explaining that signing into the correct account preserves and restores saved desktop pets. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account clarity essential during authentication.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Activity Mascot Tip Stream: Add an interactive tip carousel component to the waiting screen that shares tips on how to interact with the pet while rendering finishes. (why: Home waiting step has a high mean duration of 2336s, and support emails note confusion on how to control or talk to pets post-onboarding.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Quick Controls Overview Screen: Insert a dedicated new screen after home welcome that visually explains desktop controls such as hiding, moving, and chatting with the pet. (why: 3 support emails complained about post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
3: [finish, redesign] Interactive Tray Launch Checklist Welcome Redesign: Redesign the home_intro screen into an interactive checklist layout showing how the pet resides in the taskbar and system tray. (why: Finish step has 75.6% completion and long mean times; addressing taskbar visibility directly prevents post-onboarding confusion.)
4: [home, wait_info] Estimated Render Time Remaining Counter: Add an explicit estimated time remaining timer component on the waiting screen to set clear expectations while pet rendering completes. (why: Home waiting median time is 201s with a high mean of 2336s; wait_info changes have proven effective in past rounds.)
5: [adoption, hint] Custom Generation Quality Assurance Hint: Add a reassurance hint on the photo upload screen explaining how photo selection affects the generated pet quality. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results during adoption.)
6: [sign_in, hint] Instant Sign-In Stalling Safety Hint: Add a troubleshooting hint on the sign-in screen guiding users if the sign-in window is slow or blocked. (why: 2 support emails noted that the sign-in screen did not appear or stalled before loading.)
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Control & Visibility Reassurance Copy: Update headline and body on home_intro to clearly describe how to bring the pet back if hidden. (why: Addresses support mail confusion regarding lost or hidden pets after onboarding while reassuring users who complete onboarding.)
